strongest_angle: Examine how Josh Wander, founder of Miami-based 777 Partners, orchestrated a massive $500 million fraud scheme before pleading guilty in federal court.

key_facts.fact: Josh Wander, co-founder of Miami-based investment firm 777 Partners, pleaded guilty in Manhattan federal court to wire fraud and securities fraud charges.
Federal prosecutors stated that Josh Wander orchestrated a scheme to bilk lenders and investors out of at least $500 million before 777 Partners collapsed.
Josh Wander, aged 45, agreed to pay back $500 million in losses caused by the massive fraud scheme tied to 777 Partners.

quotes.text: An American businessman whose firm invested in several European soccer clubs that struggled under its ownership pleaded guilty to fraud charges Thursday in New York and agreed to pay back $500 million in losses caused by the scheme.
quotes.speaker: Associated Press
